identity_bridge: TDLR TABS2027001697 (registered 2026-09-22) and TABS2027001985 (2026-09-25), both 'DFW1-DC1-DH1.2 - Project Atlas': additions of electrical equipment, hot-aisle containment and demountable partitions to existing space in facility DFW1-DC1 at 6431 Longhorn Drive, Irving 75063, Dallas County; owner Quality Technology Services LLC, 22271 Broderick Drive, Sterling VA, the U.S. headquarters address printed on QTS's own pages.

QTS's Irving campus page describes Irving 1 as a 56-acre master-planned campus of six facilities with 165 MW+ critical campus capacity and lists DC1 and DC2 at 6431 Longhorn Dr, DC3 at 6351, DC4 at 6311, DC5 at 6300 and DC6 at 6440 Longhorn Dr.

Parcel 322587700A1R10000 (Quality Investment Pptys Irving LLC, 21.0736 acres) has situs 6431 Longhorn Dr and contains the City of Irving 9-1-1 point for 6431 Longhorn Dr; the other six QTS parcels carry situs 6431, 6351, 6311, 6440 and 6300 Longhorn Dr and all seven share one mailing address (6601 College Blvd, Overland Park, Kansas).

The union is 55.76 geodesic acres against QTS's 56-acre campus; it has two parts separated by a strip about 18 m wide, consistent with the Longhorn Drive right of way (odd-numbered addresses lie in the western part, even-numbered in the eastern part).
alternatives_rejected: Parcel 322587700A1R10000 alone or the 9-1-1 point for 6431 Longhorn Dr: would locate DC1/DC2 only, not the campus that holds DC1-DC6.
PS LPT Properties Investors parcel at 6651 Longhorn Dr: not a QTS parcel; excluded.
Census or commercial geocoders: not used.

consistency_checks.owner_match: all seven parcel owners are QTS-named or Quality Investment Properties Irving entities sharing one mailing address
consistency_checks.registration_match: the DC1 parcel situs equals the registered 6431 Longhorn Drive
consistency_checks.area_match: 55.76 geodesic acres versus the operator's 56-acre campus
consistency_checks.inconsistency: QTS's page puts DC5 at 6300 and DC6 at 6440 Longhorn Dr, while the appraisal roll gives QTS Irving DC5 LLC situs 6440 and QTS Irving DC6 LLC situs 6300; the campus union is unaffected
